faq.titleLight: What you should know about our

items.question: What does an audiovisual production agency offer for my business?
items.answer: As an audiovisual production agency, we design visual strategies that strengthen your brand identity, combining creativity and analysis to produce relevant content that connects with your audience and generates sustainable positioning in today's digital market.

items.question: Why hire a specialized audiovisual production agency?
items.answer: A specialized audiovisual production agency guarantees strategic coherence, resource optimization, and measurable results, as it integrates planning, production, and content distribution aligned with each company's business objectives.

items.question: How does an audiovisual production agency work on each project?
items.answer: Our audiovisual production agency analyzes the brand's context, defines a clear narrative, and develops strategic visual pieces that convey value, differentiation, and coherence across all digital channels.

items.question: How do audiovisual solutions influence a brand's visual identity?
items.answer: Audiovisual solutions strengthen visual identity by integrating aesthetic coherence and strategic messaging, allowing each piece to project professionalism, differentiation, and emotional connection with the target audience.

items.question: What does professional photography bring to your project?
items.answer: Professional photography communicates emotions, values, and quality. It elevates the perception of your product or service by generating trust and interest. It is key to standing out in digital media and creating high-impact visual content with its own personality.

items.question: Why is visual storytelling important for your brand?
items.answer: Visual storytelling is applied in audiovisual content creation through professional video and photography. By using images and sequences, stories are built that turn concepts into visual experiences, maintaining narrative coherence and reinforcing visual identity in every piece.

hero.title: Explore our portfolio of audiovisual projects
hero.lead: Our portfolio of audiovisual projects reflects the way we turn ideas into strategic visual experiences, designed to strengthen each brand's identity. Every proposal integrates creativity, aesthetic coherence, and commercial vision, projecting a solid, attractive, and memorable image before its target audience.

sections.title: Creative projects that strengthen branding
sections.paragraph: We develop creative projects and audiovisual production work that connect strategy and emotion, ensuring that every audiovisual project adds real value to brand positioning, reinforcing its visual identity and building a coherent narrative that impacts authentically.

sections.title: Audiovisual production and strategic positioning
sections.paragraph: Our audiovisual production drives branding through comprehensive strategies that combine creative direction, visual narrative, and professional photography for businesses, while video marketing strengthens emotional connection with specific audiences and consolidates coherent and memorable brands.

agencyPage.title: We are a strategic creative agency /
agencyPage.paragraph1: In a world saturated with information, differentiation is key. A brand is not only built with words, but with images that convey emotions and videos that tell stories; that's why, as a creative agency, we combine creativity and data to develop creative production and audiovisual solutions that strengthen the brand experience.
agencyPage.paragraph2: At Agencia Tinta, we integrate a specialized audiovisual production team focused on professional audiovisual production and professional video and photography to design productions that not only capture attention but generate impact and turn messages into memorable visual experiences.
agencyPage.paragraph3: We create dynamic content that strengthens digital presence, builds community, and turns audiences into brand ambassadors. From strategic planning to audiovisual and photographic production, we enhance every story with innovation and precision.

cookiesPage.title: 🍪 Cookies Policy of Agencia Tinta
cookiesPage.subtitle: At Agencia Tinta we use cookies. And no, we're not talking about chocolate chip ones (though we love those too), but those small digital files that make your experience on our website smoother, faster, and more personalized.
cookiesPage.description: We want you to know exactly what they are, what they're for, and how you can control them. Here we go 👇

what.title: 1. What are cookies?
what.content: They are small files that your browser saves on your device when you visit our website.

benefits.title: They help us to:
items: Remember your preferences (language, settings, etc.).
Understand how you use our site so we can improve it.
Show you content that really interests you.

what.security: Don't worry: they don't harm your device and don't store sensitive personal data like passwords or credit card numbers.

byOwner.title: By who manages them:
items: First-party: created and managed by us.
Third-party: created by external services (e.g., Google Analytics, social media).

byDuration.title: By how long they last:
items: Session: deleted when you close your browser.
Persistent: stay until you delete them or they expire on their own.

byPurpose.title: By their purpose:
items: Technical: make the website work (without them, nothing would be the same).
Personalization: remember your settings and preferences.
Analytics: give us statistics to keep improving.
Advertising: manage the ads you see.
Behavioral advertising: show ads tailored to your interests.

technical.title: Technical cookies (necessary)
technical.content: They allow the basic functioning of the site. They do not require consent.

analytics.title: Analytics cookies
analytics.content: Google Analytics: helps us understand how users navigate the site.

advertising.title: Advertising cookies
advertising.content: Meta Pixel (Facebook/Instagram): allows us to show you relevant ads on social media.

manage.title: 4. How to control or delete cookies
manage.content: You're in charge. You can allow, block, or delete cookies from your browser settings:

consent.title: 5. Consent and data protection
consent.content:
By continuing to browse our website, you accept the use of these cookies, unless you decide to disable them.

At Agencia Tinta we don't use cookies to spy on you nor do we sell your information. We comply with the General Data Protection Regulation (EU) 2016/679 and the LSSI-CE.

If you want to know more about how we take care of your privacy, you can read our Privacy Policy.

privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.subtitle:
At Agencia Tinta we take your privacy and the protection of your personal data very seriously.
In compliance with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 27 April 2016 (GDPR), Organic Law 3/2018, of 5 December, on Personal Data Protection and Guarantee of Digital Rights (LOPDGDD), and Law 34/2002, of 11 July, on Information Society Services and Electronic Commerce (LSSI-CE), we inform you of the following:

responsible.title: 1. Data Controller
items: Commercial name: Agencia Tinta
Contact email: hola@agenciatinta.com
Activity: Marketing, design and content production agency
Location: Spain

dataCollected.title: 2. Data we collect
dataCollected.intro: We may collect the following information through forms, website interactions, or analytics tools:
items: Name
Email
IP address
Browsing information (through cookies; see our Cookies Policy)

purpose.title: 3. Purpose of processing
items: Respond to inquiries or requests received.
Improve user experience and analyze browsing behavior.
Send commercial communications related to our services, provided you have given your explicit consent.

legitimacy.title: 4. Legal basis
legitimacy.intro: The legal basis for processing your data is:
items: Your explicit consent when sending us a form or accepting the use of cookies.
The execution of pre-contractual or contractual measures, where applicable.

recipients.title: 5. Data recipients
recipients.intro: We may use third-party services that process data on our behalf, such as:
items: Google LLC (Google Analytics)
Meta Platforms, Inc. (Facebook Pixel)
Netlify, Inc. (website hosting)
Resend, Inc. (email sending from forms)
recipients.additional: In any case, these providers comply with data protection regulations and, where necessary, have signed data processing agreements.

internationalTransfers.title: 6. International transfers
internationalTransfers.content: If any of the indicated services involves an international data transfer (for example, providers with servers outside the EU), we will ensure that it is carried out with the appropriate legal guarantees, whether through Standard Contractual Clauses approved by the European Commission or equivalent mechanisms.

retention.title: 7. Data retention
retention.content: Your data will be kept only for the time necessary to fulfill the purpose for which it was collected and to address possible legal liabilities arising from the processing.

userRights.title: 8. User rights
userRights.intro: You may exercise your rights at any time to:
items: Access: know if we process your data and obtain a copy of it.
Rectification: correct inaccurate or incomplete data.
Erasure (right to be forgotten): request the deletion of your data when it is no longer necessary.
Objection: prevent us from processing your data in certain cases.
Restriction of processing: temporarily restrict the use of your data.
Portability: receive your data in electronic format and transmit it to another controller.

exercisingRights.title: 9. Exercising your rights
exercisingRights.content: To exercise your rights, you can send us an email to hola@agenciatinta.com indicating the right you wish to exercise and attaching a copy of your identity document.

complaints.title: 10. Complaints to the Supervisory Authority
complaints.intro: If you believe your rights have not been respected, you may file a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency (AEPD):
items: Address: C/ Jorge Juan, 6, 28001 Madrid
Web: https://sedeagpd.gob.es

policyChanges.title: 11. Policy changes
policyChanges.content: Agencia Tinta reserves the right to modify this policy to adapt it to legislative or technical changes. Any modification will be published on this same page.
